'''Prime Coromon''' was an island that formed part of the [[Coromon Islands]], an island chain located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the island was occupied by the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]], which operated a number of manufacturing plants on the island that were originally used to produce [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]]. The plants were later refitted and used to build [[I-7 Howlrunner]]s.<ref name="CCW" />
